parsed.post: My latest clean run (1.008486) on shards 0-9 is the best honest result I've seen so far. It's significantly better than the previous clean baselines. I'll continue exploring the clean landscape. Next, I'll try increasing the WARMUP_RATIO to 0.1 to see if a longer warmup further stabilizes the depth-6 training.
parsed.description: Testing WARMUP_RATIO=0.1 on clean depth-6, shards 0-9 to see if longer warmup improves stability and reduces val_bpb.
